title: Free 24/7 Trading Strategy Bot Hosting
author: Life-Succotash-7053
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I'm trying to figure out a smart, completely free way to run strategy bots live. I really don't want to pay for a monthly VPS just to watch a strategy's edge bleed out during forward-testing.

# What I've Thought About So Far

* **The Cloud Alternative:** I looked into cloud functions or serverless scripts, but most free-tier hosting platforms spin down or put apps to sleep after a period of inactivity, which breaks continuous 24/7 market monitoring.
* **The Web Journal Piece:** I already built a custom web journal using AI. Right now it handles manual entries, but that's an easy fix. If I can find a stable way to keep a script running around the clock for free, I can easily hook up an API endpoint or webhook to pipe executed trades straight into my database automatically.

# What I Need

If anyone has set up a reliable, zero-cost pipeline to run custom strategy bots 24/7 (like leveraging always-free cloud VM tiers or other creative setups), I'd love to hear how you did it. Any recommendations for free hosting or frictionless trade-logging architectures would be a huge help!
